motion_system: Slow surface breath: the waterline barely undulates, and dye wicks outward a few pixels around the glint on hover, like pigment spreading through water.
color_drift: Turquoise holds steady above; below, indigo drifts slowly toward navy and back, the ghost contours fading in and out of the bloom.
glow_behavior: Only the ochre glint glows, a soft amber pulse with a faint red fleck; everything else stays matte pigment.
